expectations.text: The plan names concrete discovery steps for test entrypoints (e.g. Makefile, CI, tests docs) before deep debugging
expectations.evidence: Phase 0 lists Makefile, CI workflow(s), tests/AGENTS.md, pyproject.toml/pytest.ini before later phases (plan.md §Phase 0).

expectations.text: The plan includes explicit stop criteria or iteration cap (scope, target bar, or max cycles)
expectations.evidence: Opening table: scope, target bar, iteration cap max 3, secondary bar (plan.md §Agreed scope).

expectations.text: The plan describes delegating parallel reviews or workstreams (not only serial reading)
expectations.evidence: Phase 2 table tracks A–D with parallel readonly reviewers and merge rule (plan.md §Phase 2).

expectations.text: The plan requires one consolidated quality report artifact (not only ad-hoc chat)
expectations.evidence: Phase 3: 'One Markdown document is the system of record'; references health-and-quality-report template (plan.md §Phase 3).

expectations.text: The plan rejects lowering pass thresholds or weakening flaky assertions as the fix; prefers root-cause or skip with TODO
expectations.evidence: Phase 4 and Anti-patterns: 'Do not weaken assertions or accept partial pass rates'; skip with TODO (plan.md §Phase 4, §Anti-patterns).
